body.message:
Binghatti Amber is AED 7,000/month, all-inclusive (water, electricity, internet), with a AED 1,500 refundable deposit and first and last month upfront.

Here are the other options available right now:

1BR Viridian Central Park, City Walk, AED 8,500/mo
1BR Urban Oasis, Business Bay, AED 11,000/mo
2BR Downtown Views 2, AED 8,000/mo
2BR Miraclz Tower, Arjan, AED 8,800/mo
2BR Elite Business Bay, AED 10,000/mo
2BR The Bay, Business Bay, AED 10,000/mo

All prices are all-inclusive with the same deposit structure. Which areas are you leaning towards?
